title: Multimodal deep learning detects early esophageal neoplasia and invasion depth
summary: The MUMA-EDx model fused two TResNet-based classifiers for magnifying endoscopy and endoscopic ultrasonography. Developed on 358 patients (18,420 images), it reached an AUC of 0.94 for tumour discrimination in retrospective validation and was then tested prospectively on 122 patients (8,711 images), with a reported patient-level AUC of 1.00. Invasion depth classification reached a retrospective AUC of 0.95. The prospective cohort is small and a perfect AUC suggests caution.

evidence.tested: Discrimination and invasion depth classification in a retrospective dataset and in a prospective cohort of 122 patients.
evidence.unknown: Small prospective cohort; patient-level AUC of 1.00 reported with limited cohort size; clinical benefit not shown; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Two image classifiers fused to detect early squamous neoplasia and classify invasion depth.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; affiliations from Europe PMC or Crossref where stated. Publisher full text not accessed.
